justification: Content-only: adds one 'Can you put this in front of a client?' trust/methodology block to the /for/conveyancers landing page (the Phase-0 credibility asset for the skeptical conveyancer target). Static JSX, plain next/link, reuses an already-imported icon (ShieldCheck). No logic, data, DB, or API. No PI-insurance claim is made (policy quoted, not yet bound). Grounded in the report's real government sources; RULE-4 clean (no 'free' next to the paid report; prices already valid since billing is live).

break_it.scenario: The trust block claims something not yet true — e.g. that the product carries PI insurance (only quoted, not bound) or overstates data accuracy
break_it.what_happens: A false trust claim to a liability-obsessed audience — the exact credibility own-goal Phase 0 exists to avoid
break_it.how: the block makes NO insurance claim; it states only what is verifiably true (each control traced to the published clause and page; named government sources) and explicitly frames figures as 'indicative ... not advice', sitting alongside the s10.7 certificate and a town planner; liability-word sweep returned zero flagged terms
break_it.repro: read the added section — no 'insured', 'accurate', 'guaranteed', 'comprehensive'; only sourcing + the indicative/not-advice caveat

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — confirm the Vercel PR preview build compiles /for/conveyancers (bare worktree skipped local tsc) and the trust block renders between the value grid and the pricing section. Add a PI-insurance line only once the policy is actually bound (not just quoted).
